Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Latency surge Nov 24 — request for remediation & compensation

Hi Michael,

We saw a severe tail-latency event across our production inference calls on Nov 24 between 02:04–05:30 UTC. Consumer-facing API p95 spiked to ~1.2s (our agreement is p95 < 300ms) and we also observed intermittent 5xx errors tied to KV-cache misses. The outage window impacted three of our customer-facing features and we estimate ~3.5 hours of materially degraded service for our users.

Given the customer impact and the scope, we need: (1) a remediation timeline and root-cause notes, (2) a proposal for an account-level credit to offset downstream support costs and revenue impact, and (3) confirmation that safeguards (routing/burst limits/cache fixes) will be in place.

We appreciate Redwood's speed historically — hoping we can align on a fair remedy quickly.

Thanks,
Alex Winters
Head of Platform Ops, OmniFin
alex.winters@omnifin.com
+1 415 555 0192
